acceptedAnswer.text: Tide Mobile (Tidemobile) is an independent mobile app studio based in Adana, Türkiye. It builds Modi, a mental health app, and TerraVisa, a travel and visa planning app, combining psychology, data and design.

mainEntity.name: Which apps does Tide Mobile make?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modi (mental health, live on the App Store and Google Play), TerraVisa (visa and travel planning, live on Google Play, iOS version in App Store review), LunaPara (financial awareness, in closed testing) and Reframe (CBT-based thought records, in development).

mainEntity.name: What is Modi and is it free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modi is a mental health app with a mood journal, guided meditations, psychologist-approved journeys, short self-check tests and an AI chat companion. It is free to download and its core features are free; an optional Modi Premium adds more content. It is available on iOS and Android in Turkish and English.

No. Modi does not replace therapy and does not diagnose. It is a tool that supports everyday well-being. When the chat detects risk, it directs users to professional support such as emergency services.

mainEntity.name: What is TerraVisa and is it free?

acceptedAnswer.text: TerraVisa is a travel app that shows visa requirements for your passport and political risk levels on an interactive world map. It includes a Schengen 90/180 day calculator, a visa cost calculator, a document wizard and VFS/BLS consulate appointment alerts. The app is free; an optional premium subscription adds extra features.

mainEntity.name: How can I track the Schengen 90/180 day rule?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can stay in the Schengen area for at most 90 days within any 180-day period. Add your entry and exit dates to TerraVisa's Schengen 90/180 calculator and it works out your remaining days automatically.
TerraVisa is free on Google Play for Android. The iOS version is in App Store review.
LunaPara is currently in closed testing. For early access, join the test group and become a tester on Google Play.

mainEntity.name: How can I work with Tide Mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer technical partnership to agencies and brands for mobile app development, UI/UX and interactive experiences. See the Technical Partnership page or email tidemobile.contact@gmail.com.
